- Forecast consistently underestimates true prices, especially after spikes; adjust upward by 3–5% for post-spike periods.
- Model shows early overreaction to short-term volatility; delay peak forecast by 1–2 days to match true price momentum.
- Mean reversion is overestimated; reduce forecast by 1–2% for days following strong upward moves.
- Avoid forecasting sharp declines after sustained highs; model tends to overcorrect downward; add 0.5–1.5% buffer to prevent premature drops.
- For 30-day horizon, forecast should align with 10-day average of true prices; use rolling 10-day mean as baseline for correction.
